items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sid and Daddy O’ came around to hear me play

ctx.x: So I had this trio with Ernest McCarty and a drummer name Butch McCass and we played at this supper club out on 75th and I was trying to see… Sid and Daddy O’ came around to hear me play, and I was trying to see if I could get a record deal out of them, and nothing came of it so I eventually left and came to New York. I had exhausted everything in Chicago that I had, but let us go back.
So, the chronology is, you're already out of high school, you're working professionally and then if you could talk about your relationship with Wilson Jr. College?
